name: tCDP transferFrom debits the wrong allowance
summary: tCDP.transferFrom(from, to, value) moves the balance and then debits _allowed[msg.sender][to] instead of _allowed[from][msg.sender], so a caller that approved itself can move anyone's tokens. In its constructor the attack contract approved itself, pulled all 2.11 tETH-DAI from the three holders, and burned them, repaying the position's 169.76 DAI Compound debt with 0.1 ETH swapped to DAI and redeeming its 100.37 cETH of collateral.
notes: Loss is the cETH collateral that left tCDP; the 169.76 DAI of its debt that the attacker repaid with its own 0.1 ETH is not subtracted (rule 11). The earlier transferFrom/burn exercises found by campaign.mjs are holders burning their own tokens in 2020-2021; the contract was idle from block 11607944 until the anchor.
